subject: BlueBridge integration cadence & security artifact flow
messages:
From: Emma Blake <emma@bluebridgegrc.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@bluebridgegrc.com
Date: 2026-11-12T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: BlueBridge partnership kickoff — integration cadence and artifact flow

Hi Rachel and Soojin,

Thanks for taking this on. BlueBridge is excited to begin a tighter integration so our customers can request SOC2 evidence and pen-test artifacts directly through Redwood's partner connector. Attached is a short SOW and our artifact schema CSV to help your engineering and compliance teams map fields.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm how Redwood wants to receive artifacts (S3 pull, secure upload, or API push).
- Agree on a delivery cadence for periodic artifacts (monthly pen-test summaries vs ad-hoc reports).
- Clarify redaction/PII rules and the canonical artifact naming scheme.

For the SOW signature, I'm looping procurement. We can do a 30-minute technical sync this week — I'm available Thu 11/12 2–4pm PT or Fri 11/13 9–11am PT.

Attachments: bb_integration_sow_v1.pdf (PDF), bluebridge-artifacts-schema.csv (CSV)

Best,
Emma Blake
Partnerships Lead — BlueBridge GRC
emma@bluebridgegrc.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Blake <emma@bluebridgegrc.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-12T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BlueBridge partnership kickoff — integration cadence and artifact flow

Emma — thanks, and welcome.

High level we prefer an API-push into a scoped evidence bucket (Redwood-managed S3) with pre-signed write tokens for partners; we can also accommodate S3 pull if partners want to push to their bucket and give Redwood read access. I'll let Kar (partner engineering) confirm details.

Suggested agenda for the technical sync:
- Artifact transport options (API push vs partner S3) — Kar to lead
- Artifact schema mapping and required fields — Soojin to validate against our SOC2 evidence model
- Redaction rules & PII checklist — joint review (10–15 min)
- Operational cadence & SLAs for ad-hoc vs scheduled uploads
- DocuSign SOW questions (procurement)

Proposed time: Fri 11/13 9:30–10:00am PT (30 min). If that works I'll send a calendar invite and a short meeting doc.

CC: Karthik Iyer (Partner Engineering), Vanessa Ortiz (Partner Ops) — please note the requested artifacts.csv and advise on token lifecycle and retention defaults.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Marco Ruiz <mruiz@pentestco.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai, emma@bluebridgegrc.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-12T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BlueBridge partnership kickoff — integration cadence and artifact flow

Rachel / Emma — looping in PenTestCo to describe how we typically deliver artifacts to partners. We can push a zipped bundle to your S3 (preferred) or deliver signed URLs for each report. Our standard artifact set (and what the CSV maps) is: executive-summary.pdf, findings.csv, remediation-appendix.pdf, raw-logs.tar.gz (where allowed).

Notes / constraints:
- Raw logs require a customer NDA and sometimes redaction; share your redaction policy and we'll apply filters before export.
- For automated ingestion, filenames should include customer-id / test-id / date (e.g., cust-123_test-456_20261101.zip).
- We publish a short manifest.json with metadata; if Redwood would like a different format we can output CSV instead.

Action items for the sync:
1) Confirm method (we prefer S3 push to your scoped bucket).
2) Confirm retention period (we can retain artifacts 90 days by default unless partner asks otherwise).
3) DocuSign for SOW — Emma, send the envelope link when ready.

DocuSign link (internal): https://docusign.com/--/envelope/1234-BlueBridge-SOW
Jira follow-up: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SEC-867

—Marco Ruiz
Technical Director, PenTestCo
security@pentestco.com

Thanks everyone — solid context. Confirming next steps from Redwood: 

Internal owners / timeline:
- Karthik (Partner Eng): scope API vs S3 token approach and share a short spec by Tue 11/17.
- Vanessa (Partner Ops): define retention defaults and partner onboarding checklist by Wed 11/18.
- Soojin (Security Partnerships): validate artifact schema against our SOC2 evidence catalog; will mark which fields require redaction and produce a short guidance doc (rdw-mfa-extract-readme.txt) by Thu 11/19.
- Rachel (Sales): finalize meeting cadence and confirm DocuSign envelope from BlueBridge procurement.

Meeting: I'll schedule the 30-min sync for Fri 11/13 9:30am PT and include a short meeting doc with the agenda and links to SEC-867. Please review the attached CSV today if possible so we can map required vs optional fields during the call.

On redaction: our baseline is to remove authentication tokens and any raw credential strings; names and non-sensitive findings are OK to pass through. We'll sign an NDA if PenTestCo needs to share raw logs.

Attachments referenced: bluebridge-artifacts-schema.csv, rdw-mfa-extract-readme.txt

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Security Partnerships — Redwood Inference
